info.name: PulseWatch API
info.description: Full PulseWatch backend API — see docs/API_Specification.md and docs/API_REFERENCE.md in the repo. Run 'Login' first (or after 'npm run seed:demo' on the backend) to populate {{accessToken}}, then 'Create Organization' to populate {{organizationId}}, then the rest of the collection in order.

item.name: Test Monitor (all configured regions, ad-hoc, not persisted)

request.description: Latest independently-checked status per configured region — e.g. us-east-1 healthy, eu-west-1 failing.

item.name: List Health Checks — filtered by region
Incident AI Intelligence (root cause + suggested fixes)

request.description: Returns aiSummary, aiRootCause { confidence, findings }, and aiSuggestedFixes.
Unified chronological view: leading health-check signal, open, notifications, acknowledge, close, AI analysis.

item.name: Status Pages
Get Public Status Page (by slug, unauthenticated)

item.description: Note the dual-purpose GET /status-pages/:slug — public unauthenticated by slug, private by ID when authenticated.
